fünfzig.et: From Middle High German vünfzic, from Old High German fimfzug, from Proto-Germanic *fimf tigiwiz. Equivalent to fünf + -zig.

fünfzehn.et: From Middle High German vünfzehen, from Old High German fimfzehan, from Proto-Germanic *fimftehun. Equivalent to fünf + zehn. Compare Dutch vijftien, West Frisian fyftjin, English fifteen, Danish femten, Gothic 𐍆𐌹𐌼𐍆𐍄𐌰𐌹𐌷𐌿𐌽 (fimftaihun).

fünfte.et: From Old High German fimfto, from Proto-Germanic *fimftô. Equivalent to fünf + -te. Cognate with English fifth, Dutch vijfde, Old Saxon fīfto.

Fünfte Kolonne.et: Calque of Spanish quinta columna; see English fifth column.
